text: I think I have just the recipe for you! The Caribbean Fruity Chicken Salad is a great fit for your dietary needs and health goals. As a gluten-free option, you don't have to worry about any gluten-containing ingredients. Plus, with 25 grams of protein per serving, it's a great way to boost your protein intake. The combination of chicken, cashew pieces, and flaked coconut provides a good balance of protein and healthy fats. And, it's ready in just 15 minutes, which fits within your time budget.
